candidates.review_note: Use remaining legal balls, wickets, and runs needed. Seven outcomes score 0..6 and consume a ball; one wicket consumes both a ball and wicket; the wide and no-ball outcomes each score one without consuming a ball. A target already reached wins before checking exhaustion. Dynamic programming proceeds by balls and then increasing runs needed, resolving the no-ball dependence. To obey truncation without rounding, store each probability as an exact integer numerator with denominator 10^(balls+need), scaling predecessor numerators by powers of ten; terminal scoring outcomes contribute exact ones. Keep only two ball layers and answer registered queries at their layer. Integer division yields the exact two-decimal percentage.
